div.head: Ine 74
div.ab: CXVIII. Gif þeowwealh Engliscne mon ofslihþ, ðonne sceal se þe hine ah weorpan hine to honda hlaforde ond magum oþþe LX scll' gesyllan wið his feore.
CXVIII. Gif ðeowwealh Engliscne monnan ofslihð, þonne sceal se ðe hine ah weorpan hine to honda hlaforde ⁊ mægum oððe LX scill. gesellan wið his feore.
Si seruus Waliscus Anglicum hominem occidat, debet ille, cuius est, reddere eum domino (suo) et parentibus aut LX solid. dare pro uita sua.
{CXVIII} Gif ðeowweahl Engliscne monnan ofslihð, þonne sceal se ðe hine ah weorpan hine to honda hlaforde ⁊ mægum oððe LX sciƚƚ gesellan wið his feore.
If a Welsh slave kills an English man, then the owner shall turn him over to the [slain man’s] lord and kin or pay 60 shillings for his life.
If a Welsh slave slays an Englishman, his owner shall hand him over to the dead man's lord and kinsmen, or purchase his life for 60 shillings.
If a Welsh slave kills an Englishman, then he who owns him shall surrender him to the lord and kinsmen [of the slain man], or pay 60 shillings for his life.

Wenn ein unfreier (Wälscher?) einen Englischen Mann erschlägt, dann soll sein Eigenthümer ihn an [des Erschlagenen] Herrn und Verwandte ausliefern oder [ihnen] 60 Schill. für das Leben jenes [Sklaven] zahlen.
If an unfree (Welsh?) man slays an Englishman, then his owner is to hand him over to the lord and kinsmen [of the slain man] or pay [them] 60 shillings for the life of that [slave].

note.label: cf.
note.quote: §23 sets the value of a Welsh slave at "50 shillings, some 60."
